name: Carnet Français
tagline: Learn French, pass the TCF, live your life in French.

app.name: CarnetTCF
app.pitch: Your pocket coach for the TCF exam: timed mock tests, listening and reading drills, vocabulary decks and a progress tracker that shows you exactly which skill to practise next.

features.title: Timed mock exams
features.text: Practise under real TCF conditions for listening, reading and language structure.

features.title: Listening drills
features.text: Short audio clips at every CEFR level, from A1 to C2, with instant feedback.

features.title: Writing & speaking prompts
features.text: Realistic tasks with model answers and a checklist for self-review.

features.title: Smart vocabulary decks
features.text: Spaced repetition brings back the words you are about to forget.

features.title: Progress tracker
features.text: See your estimated level per skill and what to focus on next.

features.title: Works offline
features.text: Study on the bus, in the metro, or anywhere without data.
